method: Manual comparison of report paragraphs with archived primary-document extracted texts. Whole-document citations; no visual PDF or live registry validation. Status applies with the stated notes. Publication wording requires editorial integration.

reviews.notes: Article 5 confirms EUR 799,483.29 / 991,359.28. The larger figure is the financing budget. The discrepancy concerns archived metadata; current database contents were not checked.
Articles 3 and 6.1 establish the study and schedule submission requirements.
Distinguish the five-day start requirement, installation on 1 April and the officially recorded 4 July deadline.
Extensions distinguish planting from other works; the decision records completion of other works on 11 October 2024.
11 July 2025 is approval of PARTIAL acceptance excluding planting, not acceptance of the entire project. Later documents record planting maintenance ending 30 March 2026.
reviews.replacement_text_draft: Η σύμβαση προβλέπει 15 μήνες συντήρησης για τα νεοεγκατεστημένα πλατύφυλλα, μετά την τρίμηνη προθεσμία εργασιών. Στις 11.07.2025 εγκρίθηκε μερική παραλαβή, με εξαίρεση τις φυτεύσεις (ΡΩ5Π4653Π8-Ο4Χ). Μεταγενέστερες πράξεις αναφέρουν λήξη της συντήρησης των φυτεύσεων στις 30.03.2026.

reviews.notes: Ten-month study stages and schedule submission are contractual. 22 May 2025 is a calculated baseline from signature, not an independently verified completion deadline; stage extensions are possible.
Preliminary-study extension to 20 December is supported. Preserve the decision wording με αναθεώρηση; do not infer a guarantee of no price adjustment.
Approval of the Megara study on 30 June 2025 is supported; study approval does not establish implementation of protection works.
Study deliverables and annual planning are supported. No numbered maintenance obligation was identified in this agreement; this is not proof that no obligation exists in every incorporated document.
Ten-month stages and schedule requirement are supported. 13 October 2025 is a calculated baseline, subject to contractual extensions.
Preliminary completion, final submission and approval dates are supported. No separate extension was identified in the seven archived matching decisions; this is a search limitation.
Annual planning obligations are supported. Absence of a numbered maintenance period is limited to the agreement reviewed.
Study submission, three-month execution period and five-day written-order rule are contractual.
Installation dates are documented. Initial August/September deadlines calculated by adding three calendar months must be labelled derived, not official dates.
Office-specific operative deadlines support the report. Latest means latest identified in the 12 August 2026 snapshot; distinguish the requested 31 July from the approved 22 July.
Weather, access problems, additional works and APE processing are reasons stated by the authorities. They have not been independently verified as physical conditions or contractor fault findings.
Article 6.7 also contains an exception: works that by their nature need no maintenance are accepted within one month of the completion certificate. Do not apply the 15-month period universally.
reviews.replacement_text_draft: Η σύμβαση προβλέπει 15 μήνες υποχρεωτικής συντήρησης και παραλαβή εντός τριμήνου μετά τη λήξη της. Το άρθρο 6.7 προβλέπει εξαίρεση για εργασίες που λόγω της φύσης τους δεν απαιτούν υποχρεωτική συντήρηση: παραλαβή εντός ενός μήνα από τη βεβαίωση περάτωσης ή την τεκμαιρόμενη έκδοσή της.

reviews.notes: Article 3.3 places execution timing in individual written work orders; no single universal start/end date follows.
The approved study proposes 12 Megara zones / 15.45 km and eight Aigaleo zones / 16.12 km. Positions may change and execution requires orders; these are not measured completed works.
Generic maintenance-cost language is present. No quantified post-work maintenance period was identified in this agreement; incorporated documents were not exhaustively audited.

The archived attachment is an approval decision for the Chalkida supplement, not independently verified evidence of a signed supplementary agreement. It states 20 May 2026 and 13 days from signing the present act.
The reasoning contains inconsistent contractor/location references (Kafetzis/Kavala versus the operative Karali/Chalkida). A copying error is an editorial inference, not an established explanation.
Agreement supports study within ten days, schedule within fifteen days and three-month works/five-day start terms.
Installation, suspensions and office-specific extensions are documented. February baseline dates are calculated, and the listed extensions are not an exhaustive sequence.

Supplement attachment is an approval decision; distinguish its twenty-day term from independently verified signing/execution. Final-measurement approval does not establish payment or final acceptance.
Agreement ends with acceptance and final account. No numbered post-work maintenance period was identified in this agreement alone.
Contractual submission/start rules are supported. The 10 March notification is referenced in a later official decision, not independently reviewed service evidence or actual commencement.
Contract sets three months with a 30 June programme constraint unless extended. July 20 extension and stated reasons are documented, not independently observed site conditions.
Biomass handling is contractual. No numbered maintenance period identified in the agreement; referenced maintenance duties prevent interpreting this as absence of all maintenance obligations.
Correction concerns the 5% guarantee, EUR 1,943.91; other terms remain unchanged, not additional project expenditure.
EUR 8,781.22 revision provision was already within the EUR 957,028.33 total; amendment does not create a new contract price.
Three months from signature is the contractual baseline, not actual work commencement. No separate fifteen-month period identified in this agreement.

Article 5 terms support three months from commencement, installation/order conditions and acceptance/final-account duration. Absence of a separate fifteen-month period is limited to reviewed agreements.

Three-month execution and fifteen-month maintenance clauses are present but differ in scope (including planting-specific wording). Do not treat every maintenance/risk obligation as identical across the three agreements.
These are management studies, with seven-month overall/four-month study and fifteen-day schedule terms. They are not themselves contracts proving cleaning execution.
May 25 extension concerns Aigaleo. January 3 approval concerns a December 15 protocol. February 13 bonus approval is not evidence of payment.
Acceptance protocol is dated 24 November 2023; 11 December 2023 is its approval date. Extension and final-measurement dates are supported.
reviews.replacement_text_draft: Η αρχική προθεσμία 27.09.2023 παρατάθηκε έως 31.10.2023, με επίκληση καθυστερήσεων λόγω καύσωνα. Η τελική επιμέτρηση εγκρίθηκε στις 10.11.2023. Το πρωτόκολλο παραλαβής συντάχθηκε στις 24.11.2023 και εγκρίθηκε στις 11.12.2023 (64Ξ64653Π8-Φ6Λ).

reviews.notes: Zero results is confirmed only for this archived reference search. Parent decisions cannot automatically be attributed to the amendment, and absence of hits is not absence of activity.
Study/install/completion and February 16 protocol approved March 13 are supported. No extension identified among the eight archived matches is a bounded search result.
Zero results is confirmed only for this archived reference search; it does not establish no administrative activity.
December extension and March 21 protocol approved April 18 are supported. Weather/access explanations are those stated in the decision.
Megara dates are supported. December 21 extension applies to Kapandriti/Lavrio and must not be assigned to Megara.

Installation and November 30 2025 completion are recorded. Compatibility with fifteen-month maintenance is an inference, not an established causal explanation. The certificate also gives a contract date inconsistent with the agreement. The alias search must remain separate from proof of execution.

March 17/20 2025 partial protocols were approved April 3. Later final approval on May 12 2026 references Aigaleo December 19 2025 protocol after maintenance; keep protocol and approval dates separate.

Megara July 15 2024 protocol was approved July 29. Its early acceptance needs reconciliation with the agreement fifteen-month maintenance provision; the reviewed record does not explain applicability or an exception. No breach is inferred.
Work-order, extensions and study approvals are documented. Causes are official stated reasons. Approval of a study is distinct from executing its proposed works.
Order, extensions, April study approvals and July first-account approval are supported. Account approval is not proof of payment.
